integrity: The mathematical counterexample is proved by explicit disk mapping, close-to-convex univalence and exact rational series. Finite verifier checks arithmetic, not global univalence. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The global sharp third-Hankel supremum is not determined.
The witness does not classify all extremizers.
No diagnosis of the earlier proof discrepancy is claimed.
title: An exact Hankel witness above two proposed bounds in the symmetric H-domain class
